Calcutta HC orders voice sample for TMC leader in speech case

The Calcutta High Court has directed Trinamool Congress leader Abhishek Banerjee to provide a voice sample in connection with a case involving alleged provocative speeches. This directive comes amidst ongoing political discourse and legal scrutiny surrounding statements made by various political figures in West Bengal. The case highlights the legal challenges faced by politicians regarding their public pronouncements.
